title: Hashing & Prefix-Sum Drill
subtitle: Your practice list — 9 problems, one technique, rising difficulty
description: A focused drill on the most reused tool in Infosys Q1/Q2: **hash maps**, and their combination with **prefix sums**. Solve in order; each problem adds one idea to the previous one.

steps.title: Counting with a hash map
steps.goal: Frequency counting and its common output formats.
tips: Counter(s) then iterate in the order the problem demands

steps.title: Sorting by frequency & grouping
steps.goal: Use counts as sort keys and canonical keys for grouping.

steps.title: Prefix sum + hashing (combines both topics)
steps.goal: Remember earlier prefix sums to answer subarray questions in O(N).
tips: Replace 0 with −1 → equal 0s and 1s means subarray sum 0
